What the controls reveal

Rate changes the recurring pulse. The 0.2, 0.3, and 0.5 Hz renders each show their strongest slow energy modulation at the chosen rate.

Range and position change the output. Moving through a smaller region, shifting its center, or holding a second coordinate elsewhere changes the model’s sound and level. The coordinates do not have fixed labels such as “snore,” “breath,” or “calm.”

This recreates the patch’s control logic at 44.1 kHz. A running Max patch can differ in phase, audio settings, gain, and random noise. The oscillator is drawn at its input phase; model latency remains in the output.

Reference: cycle~ uses a cosine waveform by default. nn~ converts the incoming signal to the model’s latent sample rate.
